nodes.name: build.ts
nodes.summary: Core build calculation engine. Accumulates equipment stats/perks, computes CDR, boosts, crit, and derives final build results from a BuildState.

nodes.name: calcCDR
nodes.summary: Calculates cooldown reduction for runes and weapon arts from perks, race modifiers, emotional state, and toggle states.

nodes.name: calcBoosts
nodes.summary: Computes damage boost multipliers from perks, race effects, level, and contextual conditions (potency, darkness, mount, etc.).

nodes.name: accumulateEquipment
nodes.summary: Aggregates stats and perks from all equipment slots (armor, ring, rune, weapon) including enchantments and infusions.

nodes.name: accumulateMonkWeapon
nodes.summary: Accumulates stats and perks from monk glove and essence with shrine and rank multipliers.

nodes.name: accumulateStandardWeapon
nodes.summary: Accumulates stats and perks from blade and handle weapon parts with optional shrine.

nodes.name: processEnchantedSlot
nodes.summary: Applies enchantments to a single equipment slot and merges resulting stats and perks.

nodes.name: finalizePerks
nodes.summary: Applies perk effectiveness, Cursed modifier, Buckler->Parry merge, and potency grantor perks to the final perk map.

nodes.name: deriveResults
nodes.summary: Takes raw stats and finalized perks to compute CDR, stat boosts, crit, buffs, and final damage boosts, returning a complete BuildResult.

nodes.name: calcBuild
nodes.summary: Main public entry point. Accumulates equipment, finalizes perks, and derives the full BuildResult from a BuildState.

nodes.name: applyEmotionalAttackSpeed
nodes.summary: Adds attack speed bonus from Emotional perk when in debuffs emotional state.

nodes.name: applyGladiatorialRage
nodes.summary: Converts highest offensive boost stat into armor penetration via Gladiatorial Rage perk.

nodes.name: computeBuffs
nodes.summary: Assembles active buffs from build state and calculates Ork tenacity bonus from buffs.

nodes.name: maxBuffPotency
nodes.summary: Returns the maximum potency value across all buffs matching the given name(s).

nodes.name: CDRResult
nodes.summary: Result of cooldown reduction calculation containing rune/wa CDR multipliers and step breakdowns.

nodes.name: BuildResult
nodes.summary: Complete build calculation result containing stats, perks, CDR, boosts, and crit.

nodes.name: data.ts
nodes.summary: Barrel re-export module for character, equipment, and weapon data accessors.

nodes.name: character.ts
nodes.summary: Loads and provides typed accessors for race, guild, and perk data from JSON files.

nodes.name: getRace
nodes.summary: Looks up a Race by name from the pre-built map.

nodes.name: getGuild
nodes.summary: Looks up a Guild by name from the pre-built map.

nodes.name: getPerk
nodes.summary: Looks up a Perk definition by name from the pre-built map.

nodes.name: getGuildRank
nodes.summary: Finds a specific rank within a guild's ranks array.

nodes.name: isMonkGuild
nodes.summary: Returns true if the guild name is 'Monk'.

nodes.name: equipment.ts
nodes.summary: Loads and provides typed accessors for armor, ring, rune, and enchantment data from JSON files.

nodes.name: getArmorPart
nodes.summary: Retrieves a specific armor part (Helmet/Chestplate/Leggings) from a named armor set.

nodes.name: getEnchant
nodes.summary: Looks up an Enchantment by name from the pre-built map.

nodes.name: armorSupportsSlot
nodes.summary: Returns whether a named armor set supports a given slot type (Helmet/Chestplate/Leggings).

nodes.name: weapons.ts
nodes.summary: Loads and provides typed accessors for weapon blade, handle, glove, and essence data from JSON files.

nodes.name: getBlade
nodes.summary: Looks up a WeaponBlade by name.

nodes.name: getHandle
nodes.summary: Looks up a WeaponHandle by name.

nodes.name: getGlove
nodes.summary: Looks up a MonkGlove by name.

nodes.name: getEssence
nodes.summary: Looks up a MonkEssence by name.

nodes.name: dmgTypeBonuses.ts
nodes.summary: Computes per-damage-type bonus multipliers from perks like Void Rage, Channeled Weapon, Emotional, and Draconic Blood.

nodes.name: buildDmgTypeBonuses
nodes.summary: Builds a map of damage type -> bonus multiplier from qualifying perks, applying conditions and optional exclusions.

nodes.name: enchant.ts
nodes.summary: Enchantment application system: applies stat modifiers to equipment slots, handles perk effectiveness scaling, infusion, and enchant slot exclusivity enforcement.

nodes.name: applyEnchantmentsToSlot
nodes.summary: Applies a list of enchantments to an equipment slot's base stats and perks in two phases: selector transforms then direct modifiers, with upgrade support.

nodes.name: applyPerkEffectiveness
nodes.summary: Scales all non-exempt perks by (1 + 0.1*stacks) for both Perk Effectiveness and Cursed.

nodes.name: applyInfusion
nodes.summary: Applies infusion to equipment by halving all stat values and copying perks.

nodes.name: enforceEnchantSlot
nodes.summary: Enforces exclusive enchantment rules: removes duplicates and ensures exclusive enchants occupy the first slot alone.

nodes.name: applyModsToKey
nodes.summary: Applies a list of stat modifiers (multiplier or addition) to a single stat key's mult/add accumulators.

nodes.name: applyModsWhere
nodes.summary: Applies stat modifiers to all stat keys matching a predicate condition.

nodes.name: engine.ts
nodes.summary: Top-level barrel re-export for the entire engine module (data, shrine, enchant, weapon, build, format).

nodes.name: format.ts
nodes.summary: Formatting utilities for stat display: adds signs, percentage suffixes for percent stats, and human-readable labels.

nodes.name: formatStat
nodes.summary: Formats a stat value with +/- sign and optional % suffix for percent stats.

nodes.name: formatLabel
nodes.summary: Converts camelCase stat keys into human-readable labels (e.g. 'physicalBoost' -> 'Physical Boost').

nodes.name: shrine.ts
nodes.summary: Shrine multiplier system: applies tier-based stat/scaling multipliers to equipment (tier 1 = 3x, tier 5 = 1x).

nodes.name: applyShrineToStats
nodes.summary: Multiplies all stat values in a StatMap by the shrine multiplier for the given tier.

nodes.name: applyShrineToScalings
nodes.summary: Multiplies all scaling values by the shrine multiplier for the given tier.

nodes.name: weapon.ts
nodes.summary: Weapon calculation engine: resolves weapon types, merges blade/handle stats and scalings, detects hybrid bonuses, and handles monk weapon special rules.

nodes.name: calcWeapon
nodes.summary: Public API: calculates a standard weapon result from blade and handle names with optional shrine.

nodes.name: calcMonkWeapon
nodes.summary: Public API: calculates a monk weapon result from glove and essence names with shrine and rank-based stat bonuses.

nodes.name: calcWeaponGeneric
nodes.summary: Generic weapon calculation shared by standard and monk paths: extracts damage/scalings, merges parts, resolves type.

nodes.name: resolveWeaponType
nodes.summary: Resolves the final weapon type name from handle/blade combination and applicable perk overrides (Dual Wielding, Kama Blades, etc.).

nodes.name: checkHybrid
nodes.summary: Detects hybrid weapon state when blade and handle each contribute unique, non-overlapping scaling types.

nodes.name: mergeScalingsAndStats
nodes.summary: Merges two weapon parts' scalings and stats, applying shrine multipliers and hybrid 1.5x scaling bonus.

nodes.name: extractDamageAndScalings
nodes.summary: Extracts damage type values, scaling values, and stat values from a weapon part object.

nodes.name: buildWeaponResult
nodes.summary: Assembles the final WeaponResult object from extracted and merged weapon part data.

nodes.name: applyMonkStatBonus
nodes.summary: Applies shrine + monk rank stat bonus to a weapon part's stats, patching result fields in-place.

nodes.name: WeaponResult
nodes.summary: Complete weapon calculation result containing damage types, scalings, stats, weapon type info, and part-level details.

nodes.name: Modal.svelte
nodes.summary: Reusable modal dialog component with overlay, fly/fade transitions, focus trapping, close button, and global modal styling classes.

nodes.name: Modal
nodes.summary: Base modal component providing overlay backdrop, animated dialog box, focus management, and slot-based content rendering.

nodes.name: AccessorySelectModal.svelte
nodes.summary: Modal for selecting armor (helmet/chestplate/leggings), ring, rune, or infusion items with effective boost sorting and stat display.

nodes.name: AccessorySelectModal
nodes.summary: Equipment selection modal supporting armor slots, ring, rune, and infusion with search, filtering, effective boost computation, and stat pill display.

nodes.name: computeItemEffectiveBoost
nodes.summary: Computes the effective damage boost of an item by multiplying its stats against the weapon's scalings.

nodes.name: computeItemBrawnyBoost
nodes.summary: Computes a Brawny-perk-adjusted effective boost by converting non-physical offensive boosts to physical before scaling.

nodes.name: GuildModal.svelte
nodes.summary: Modal for selecting a guild and rank with search, tag filtering, and display of rank stats and perks.

nodes.name: GuildModal
nodes.summary: Guild selection modal with rank buttons, stat pills, perk tags, search filtering, and DidYouMean suggestions.

nodes.name: index.ts
nodes.summary: Barrel re-export for all modal components: RaceModal, GuildModal, AccessorySelectModal, WeaponPartModal.

nodes.name: RaceModal.svelte
nodes.summary: Modal for selecting a character race with search, display of passive description and stat modifiers.

nodes.name: RaceModal
nodes.summary: Race selection modal listing all races with passive text, stat modifier pills, and search highlighting.

nodes.name: WeaponPartModal.svelte
nodes.summary: Modal for selecting weapon parts (blade, handle, glove, essence) with tier/type filtering, stat display, and weapon stat filter integration.

nodes.name: WeaponPartModal
nodes.summary: Weapon part selection modal with tier/type dropdowns, weapon stat include/exclude filters, badge display, and WeaponStatsDisplay integration.

nodes.name: StatFilterShared.svelte
nodes.summary: Reusable stat filter chip component with include/exclude/dimmed states and a module-level buildStatMaps utility.

nodes.name: StatFilterChip
nodes.summary: Toggle chip button for stat filters with three states (include=+, exclude=-, off) and keyboard context menu support.

nodes.name: buildStatMaps
nodes.summary: Module-level utility that builds label and color lookup maps from grouped stat definitions.

nodes.name: elementalBoosts.ts
nodes.summary: Defines elemental boost stat definitions and their negative counterparts for filter/sort UI.

nodes.name: filterActions.ts
nodes.summary: Generic filter state management with toggle (include/exclude/off), remove, clear, and keyboard handling actions.

nodes.name: createFilterActions
nodes.summary: Factory that returns toggle/remove/clear/handleChipKeyDown actions operating on a getActive/setActive/notify triplet.

nodes.name: store.ts
nodes.summary: Svelte writable/derived stores for the build state with localStorage persistence, derived calcBuild result, and mutation helpers (enchantments, guild, armor/ring slot moves).

nodes.name: setEnchantment
nodes.summary: Updates a single enchantment slot index with enforcement of exclusive enchant rules.

nodes.name: setGuild
nodes.summary: Sets guild name and rank, resetting weapon slots between monk/non-monk and applying draconic race defaults.

nodes.name: moveArmorSlot
nodes.summary: Swaps or clones an armor item between equipment/infusion slots with type compatibility checks.

nodes.name: moveRingSlot
nodes.summary: Swaps or clones a ring item between ring/infusionRing slots.

nodes.name: toast.ts
nodes.summary: Toast notification store: manages a list of toasts with add (auto-expire) and remove operations.

nodes.name: addToast
nodes.summary: Creates a new toast with auto-removal after specified duration, returns its ID.

nodes.name: removeToast
nodes.summary: Removes a toast by ID from the store.

nodes.name: Toast.svelte
nodes.summary: Toast notification display component: renders toasts from the store with fly-in transition, type-based styling/icons, and dismiss button.

nodes.name: Toast
nodes.summary: Fixed-position toast container displaying active toasts with animated entry, color-coded types (success/error/info/warning), and per-toast dismiss.

nodes.name: types.ts
nodes.summary: Core type definitions and constants for the entire application: StatKey/StatMap, equipment types (Race, Guild, Armor, Ring, Rune, WeaponBlade, etc.), BuildState interface, upgrade logic, and damage type constants.

nodes.name: applyUpgrade
nodes.summary: Applies upgrade level multiplier to stats: positive values scale up, negative values scale down (divided by mult).

nodes.name: canProc
nodes.summary: Returns whether a ProcCoefficient allows procs (value > 0).

nodes.name: BuildState
nodes.summary: Complete application state for a build: race, guild, equipment slots, enchantments, upgrades, toggles, and combat parameters.

nodes.name: WeaponBaseDmg
nodes.summary: Defines a weapon's base damage pattern with M1/M2 hit arrays, finisher flags, and charge mechanics.

nodes.name: Badge.svelte
nodes.summary: Reusable badge/tag UI component with color variants, size options, solid/outline modes, and optional monospace font.

nodes.name: Badge
nodes.summary: Inline badge element supporting 9 color variants (green/amber/red/purple/blue/teal/muted/draco/default), 3 sizes, solid mode, and dynamic color via style props.
